sources_considered.why: Read to establish scope only. It does not enumerate the arguments covered by many and is not used as evidence that Marcus was right.
Read as a concrete example of opposition. Selecting this letter would not establish that it represents the unspecified collection Marcus intended.
Legislative versions could settle particular textual allegations, but cannot supply the missing collection or meaning of many.

unresolved_gaps: No bounded set of alleged misrepresentations is specified.
No stable threshold distinguishes many from a few.
Predictions about innovation or company departures cannot simply be graded as incorrect descriptions of the bill.
